The whole day in one place

Outside the summer season the whole complex belongs to your wedding party alone. Hold the ceremony by the reservoir or right on the stage; the reception takes place on the covered terrace and 37 of your closest guests can stay on site. We recommend 100 to 130 guests, 150 at most.

  • Terrace that closes with curtains and has an infrared heater above every table, so weddings work in winter too
  • Common room with fireplace as the base for catering and dining
  • Stage for the ceremony or band (covered hot tub)
  • Terrace kiosk (beer tap, coffee machine, combi oven, dishwasher, deep fryer), included with our catering
  • Dance floor, fire pit with grill
  • Catering from us or from anyone you like, at no extra charge
  • Beer and lemonade in kegs, straight from the tap
  • Free late check-out at 14:00 with all wedding packages
Before you choose

Good to know in advance

Everything important in one place.

Wedding rules

  • Weddings are booked as a wedding package. A standard rental of the whole complex is only for accommodating the guests named in the booking.
  • We host weddings from September to June. In July and August the complex is not rented as a whole.
  • We recommend 100 to 130 guests, 150 at most. Up to 37 guests can stay overnight (29 beds and 8 extra beds in 5 apartments).
  • The reception is on the covered terrace; the common room serves as the base for catering and dining.
  • Food is not included in any package: catering from us, from another supplier, or your own.
  • Check-in from 15:00, check-out with wedding packages free until 14:00.
  • Please turn the music down after 22:00; complete quiet from midnight.
  • Beer and lemonade in kegs are supplied only by us; your own wine and spirits are free of charge.
  • Parking: the 10 spaces at the complex are for overnight guests, other guests park nearby along the road. Camping and caravans are not allowed around the complex.

Payment and viewing

  • 50 % advance payment by bank transfer within 14 days of the advance invoice. Once it is paid, the date is yours.
  • Balance by bank transfer no later than 14 days before arrival.
  • Refundable security deposit by bank transfer no later than 3 days before arrival: CZK 10,000 for 2 nights.
  • What is added to the price (cleaning, tourist tax, electricity) is listed with the package comparison.
  • We will gladly arrange a visit beforehand: tick it in the enquiry form or call +420 775 704 669.

Added to the price

  • Cleaning, handover and bed linen: CZK 1,950 per stay.
  • Tourist tax set by the municipality: CZK 20 per person per night. It is included in the booking price according to the number of guests; any difference from the actual number is settled from the security deposit. Children under 18 do not pay it.
  • Electricity by actual consumption: CZK 8/kWh, in winter up to about CZK 3,000 a day. Deducted from the security deposit.
  • Refundable security deposit: CZK 10,000 for 2 nights, by bank transfer no later than 3 days before arrival.
  • Cleaning after the wedding: the CZK 1,950 covers standard cleaning. Cleaning the terrace, common room and surroundings after the event is charged by the hours worked, CZK 350 per person per hour, or you can clean them yourselves.

Peace and location

Below Cornštejn, close to the water

Panelcz stands in the holiday settlement of Chmelnice on the shore of the Vranov reservoir, below the ruins of Cornštejn castle. Outside the summer season it is quiet here: no traffic, just forest, water and your group. A loud party disturbs no one, yet Znojmo is only 35 minutes away.

  • Sandy beach about 100 m from the complex
  • Cornštejn ruins and Bítov castle within sight
  • Fenced complex, parking for 10 cars right next to it
  • Close to Podyjí National Park
